summary: Independent end-to-end verification of the reworked Trip Inspection feature (single multipart POST /trip-inspection/analyze, exterior 12-category set + optional interior 6-category set). All 5 review-request items PASSED against the live preview backend with real Gemini (gemini:gemini-3.1-pro-preview).
test_scope: Frontend-only on https://damage-cases.preview.emergentagent.com/trip as admin@riyadah.tech / DamageAdmin#2026 (TENANT-000001). 5 flows: page render, exterior-only analyze, exterior+interior analyze, partial-interior validation, initial analyze-disabled state.
steps_executed: Downloaded all 4 reference images (EXTERIOR_BEFORE/AFTER + INTERIOR_BEFORE/AFTER) to /tmp/. Created per-test copies so set_input_files always fires the React onChange.
Login (email+password explicitly filled, NOT pre-filled) -> redirected off /login. Navigated to /trip. trip-root rendered.
Verified intro text contains the new keywords: chips, wheels, rust, vandalism, dirt, fluid leaks, seats, dashboard. Both 'Exterior' (required) and 'Interior' (optional) headers present.
TEST 5 (initial state): trip-analyze is disabled with no photos uploaded. PASS.

TEST 4 (validation): uploaded only INTERIOR_BEFORE plus both exterior photos. trip-analyze becomes enabled (because exterior pair is complete) -> click -> client-side error 'For interior analysis, please add BOTH an interior Before and After photo (or remove the one you added).' rendered in [data-testid=trip-error]. trip-result NOT rendered. PASS.

TEST 2 (exterior-only): reset, uploaded ext_before + ext_after, clicked Analyze. trip-result appeared. Banner: 'New damage detected this trip'. Only trip-section-exterior present (no trip-section-interior). 2 bbox markers over annotated exterior after image. Findings: #1 Glass NEW (rear window, shattered, 95%), #2 Lights NEW (left tail light, broken, 95%). Count chips: Glass 1/1 new, Lights 1/1 new. PASS.

TEST 3 (exterior + interior): reset, uploaded all four photos, clicked Analyze, waited ~120-180s. trip-result appeared with BOTH trip-section-exterior AND trip-section-interior. Exterior findings: Glass NEW (rear window) + Lights NEW (left tail light). Interior findings: #1 Seats NEW (driver seat, large tear in cushion, 99%), #2 Stains/dirt NEW (passenger seat, large brown spill, 99%). 2 bbox markers over interior annotated after image. Overall: 4 new issues. PASS.

feature_verification.page_layout_two_sections: PASS - Exterior (required) + Interior (optional) headers and 4 dropzones rendered
feature_verification.expanded_category_intro_text: PASS - all required keywords present (chips, wheels, rust, vandalism, dirt, fluid leaks, seats, dashboard, etc.)
feature_verification.exterior_only_flow: PASS - GLASS NEW + LIGHT NEW with bounding boxes, single exterior section, banner correct
feature_verification.exterior_plus_interior_flow: PASS - both sections rendered; interior detects SEAT (torn driver seat) + STAIN (coffee spill on passenger seat) as NEW, with bbox markers
feature_verification.partial_interior_validation: PASS - blocks submission and surfaces correct error message in trip-error
feature_verification.analyze_disabled_until_exterior_ready: PASS - button disabled on initial load

critical_code_review_comments: Validation message in TripInspection.jsx triggers AFTER the user clicks Analyze. UX could be improved by disabling Analyze (or showing inline hint near the interior section) the moment interior is partial; this is non-blocking.

File <input> elements are intentionally hidden; this is fine for set_input_files but any future tester using locator.wait_for() with default visibility=true on these inputs will time out. Already documented in iteration_10 context.
seed_data_creation: None. Trip Inspection is ephemeral; backend deletes uploaded images right after analyze.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trip Inspection v2 (single multipart POST /trip-inspection/analyze with optional interior pair) verified working end-to-end against real Gemini. IMPORTANT testing nuance: after clicking trip-reset and re-uploading the same physical file path into the same hidden <input>, React's onChange does NOT re-fire (the input's File object is identical). Always use distinct file paths/copies (e.g. /tmp/ext_before_2.png, /tmp/ext_before_3.png) for each successive upload OR clear the input value via page.evaluate before set_input_files. Login form is NOT pre-filled; explicitly fill email + password. trip-* file inputs are hidden by design — use page.set_input_files without waiting for visibility.
